message.content: {"answer": "E", "option_text": "Silicosis with nodular opacities", "reason": "The chest X-ray demonstrates bilateral, predominantly upper and mid-zone reticulo-nodular opacities (indicated by blue arrows) without cavitation, honeycombing, or massive mediastinal widening. This pattern of discrete nodular opacities in the upper lobes is the classic radiographic presentation of silicosis (a form of pneumoconiosis), distinguishing it from the basal predominance of fibrosis or the cavitary lesions of TB."}
